description: Reference example: topology map for a brain-corp ecosystem with provider, client and standalone sidecars. Copy this file to system-map.json if you want to start from a populated topology.

repositories.name: example-api
repositories.description: API that exposes data and business rules to other sidecars.

repositories.name: example-web
repositories.description: Web application that consumes the provider sidecar API.

repositories.name: example-app
repositories.description: Autonomous application that does not depend on other sidecars.

groups.name: example
groups.description: Example group: provider + client coupled by API.

rootOrchestration.rule: All commands and skills operate from the brain-corp root. Sidecar paths are resolved from config/system-map.json; changing directories is never required.

notes: This file is a structure reference only; the active map is config/system-map.json.
Available roles are provider, client and standalone.
Use `brain setup` to generate the map from your real repositories.
